{{Elections in Ohio sidebar}}
The '''2026 Ohio Supreme Court election''' were held on November 3, 2026, to elect two justices to the [[Supreme Court of Ohio]]. Primary elections were held on May 5, 2026.

[[Ohio Democratic Party|Democrats]] won both seats up for election, with district court judge [[Marilyn Zayas]] unseating incumbent justice [[Daniel R. Hawkins]] and incumbent justice [[Jennifer Brunner]] narrowly winning re-election.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Griffin |first=Daniel |last2=Conn |first2=Adam |last3=Benatar |first3=Orri |date=November 3, 2026 |title=Ohio election results: Democrats take most statewide offices, both Supreme Court races |url=https://www.nbc4i.com/news/your-local-election-hq/ohio-election-results-statewide-offices-supreme-court-races/ |access-date=November 4, 2026 |website=nbc4i.com |publisher=WCMH-TV}}</ref>
